575.grammar: prp of na gaṇhāti, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: yattha pana mahantaṃ paribhavaṃ paṭilabhati, tattha ciram'pi vasati. so nivatth'avatthe jiṇṇe pilotikakhaṇḍena tasmim'pi jiṇṇe kenaci dinnaṃ aggaṇhanto hirikopīna-paṭicchādana-matten'eva carati. evaṃ gacchante kāle ekaṃ nigamagāmaṃ agamāsi.
pabbajam'pi ca anomanikkamo, aggataṃ vajati sabbapāṇinaṃ, tena uttaritaro na vijjati, sabbalokam'abhibhuyya viharatī'ti.

577.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of agga
577.meaning1: before one's eyes; right in front of one; in one's presence
577.commentary: (THIa) māyaṃ viya aggato katan'ti māyākārena purato upaṭṭhāpitaṃ māyāsadisaṃ.

examples.text: māyaṃ viya aggato kataṃ, supin'ante'va suvaṇṇapādapaṃ, upagacchasi andha rittakaṃ, janamajjhe'r'iva rupparūpakaṃ.

579.meaning1: wanting fire; in need of fire

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhūmija, puriso agg'atthiko aggigavesī aggipariyesanaṃ caramāno allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya abhimantheyya.

581.meaning2: gift of the best; highest offering

582.meaning1: giving the best; providing the foremost

examples.text: yo aggadāyī varadāyī, seṭṭhadāyī ca yo naro, dīgh'āyu yasavā hoti, yattha yatth'ūpapajjatī'ti.

583.meaning2: top of the door or gate; (or the first gate opened; way to leave the town secretly)

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo paṭaliyo upāhanā ārohitvā khaggaṃ olaggetvā chattena dhāriyamānena aggadvārena assamaṃ pavisitvā te isayo sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme apabyāmato karitvā atikkami.

584.commentary: (ITIa) aggadhammasamāhito'ti aggena pasādadhammena dān'ādidhammena ca samāhito samannāgato acalappasādayutto, tassa vā vipākabhūtehi bahujanassa piyamanāpatādidhammehi yutto.

examples.text: aggassa dātā medhāvī, aggadhammasamāhito, devabhūto manusso vā, aggappatto pamodatī'ti.

585.meaning1: best state; highest condition; epithet of Nibbāna
585.commentary: (THa) aggadhammo'ti aggo uttamo navavidhalok'uttaro dhammo suṭṭhu aviparītaṃ desito pavedito'ti. (THIa) aggadhamman'ti phaladhammaṃ, arahattaṃ.

examples.text: namo hi tassa bhagavato, sakyaputtassa sirīmato, ten'āyaṃ aggappattena, aggadhammo sudesito'ti.
atha maṃ bhaṇatī tāto, pāpuṇa bodhiñ'ca aggadhammañ'ca, nibbānañ'ca labhassu, yaṃ sacchikarī dvipadaseṭṭho.

586.meaning1: possessing the top teaching; having the highest doctrine
586.commentary: (ITIa) aggadhammasamāhito'ti aggena pasādadhammena dān'ādidhammena ca samāhito samannāgato acalappasādayutto, tassa vā vipākabhūtehi bahujanassa piyamanāpatādidhammehi yutto.

examples.text: aggassa dātā medhāvī, aggadhammasamāhito, devabhūto manusso vā, aggappatto pamodatī'ti.
hattho nāma kapparaṃ upādāyaṃ yāva agganakhā.

589.commentary: (UDa) idaṃ agganagaran'ti tesaṃ ariy'āyatanavaṇippathānaṃ idaṃ nagaraṃ aggaṃ bhavissati jeṭṭhakaṃ pāmokkhaṃ.

examples.text: yāvatā, ānanda, ariyaṃ āyatanaṃ yāvatā vaṇippatho idaṃ agganagaraṃ bhavissati pāṭaliputtaṃ puṭabhedanaṃ. pāṭaliputtassa kho, ānanda, tayo antarāyā bhavissanti, aggito vā udakato vā mithubhedato vā'ti.

591.meaning1: that which is described as the ultimate; that which is declared eminent

examples.text: sadevake, bhikkhave, loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya tathāgato aggam'akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. imā kho, bhikkhave, catasso aggapaññattiyo'ti.
acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yatra hi nāma satthu c'eva sāvakassa ca atthena attho byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na viggayhissati, yadidaṃ aggapadasmiṃ!

593.meaning2: best trust; trust in the best

594.meaning1: best food; (or) alms for the best

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya, aho vata aham'eva labheyyaṃ bhatt'agge agg'āsanaṃ agg'odakaṃ aggapiṇḍaṃ, na añño bhikkhu labheyya bhatt'agge agg'āsanaṃ agg'odakaṃ aggapiṇḍan'ti.

597.meaning1: attained the highest; accomplished the ultimate; reached the pinnacle

examples.text: samuggatassa jhāyissa, ananugat'antarassa suddhassa, asitassa hitassa, pavivittassa aggappattassa, tiṇṇassa tārayantassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.
aggassa dātā medhāvī, aggadhammasamāhito. devabhūto manusso vā, aggappatto pamodatī'ti.

598.meaning1: highest confidence; (or) trust in the foremost
598.meaning2: best trust; trust in the best

examples.text: agge kho pana pasannānaṃ aggo vipāko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro aggappasādā'ti.
